name: Univastu India Ltd
tagline: Small-cap metro-rail EPC/systems contractor (sub-contractor/JV partner to L&T and IRCON) with an accelerating, order-book-confirmed growth ramp (Rs1,021cr+ order book, ~4x TTM revenue) and cheap-looking 18x P/E, but sharply worsening receivables and a working-capital-funded growth model temper the case.
business_overview: Univastu India Ltd operates in the construction & engineering (EPC-type) space, specialising in metro-rail civil and systems work as a sub-contractor/JV partner to majors (L&T, IRCON), alongside sports/aquatic facilities, buildings and structural projects, PWD/CIDCO Class-1A certified. Revenue has grown at a ~37% 5-year CAGR (Rs59cr FY22 -> Rs243cr FY26) and is now accelerating sharply (+252% YoY in Q1 FY27) as a large metro order book begins executing. Diversifying via MOU/JV structures into data-centres (URBS Systems AB), wireless BMS/IoT (Univastu NUOS JV) and Olympic-grade aquatics (Myrtha Pools exclusive partnership). Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@rishithegreat41, high conviction claimed).

fundamentals_narrative: This pass materially upgrades the original 'generic, low-moat EPC' framing. Univastu is a qualified sub-contractor/JV partner to L&T and IRCON on metro-rail civil and systems work (not plain civil construction), backed by a confirmed Rs1,021cr+ order book (~4.2x FY26 revenue) that is now visibly executing - Q1 FY27 revenue grew 252% YoY. The company is also diversifying via named MOU/JV structures into data-centres (URBS Systems AB, Sweden), wireless BMS/IoT (Univastu NUOS JV) and Olympic-grade aquatics (Myrtha Pools, with one Rs9cr order already booked) - real optionality, though pre-revenue at scale. Set against this, the working-capital picture has deteriorated sharply: debtor days have risen to ~121 days, the board tripled the borrowing limit to ~Rs200cr to fund working capital, and a Rs16cr preferential warrant issue was needed to bring in fresh capital - though notably the promoters themselves (Dr./Mrs. Khandagale) are among the largest warrant allottees, i.e. infusing capital rather than exiting. Net-net: a genuinely stronger, more differentiated growth story than the original pass captured, but one now running hot on working capital that needs to be watched closely.
technical_read: Trades well off its 52-week high (~Rs179) at a current price of ~Rs152, above the ~Rs56 low; not pulled in further technical detail this pass.

bse_notes: No SEBI/fraud/going-concern flags found this pass. Annual SAST Reg. 31(4) disclosure (Apr-2026) confirms nil promoter share encumbrance for FY25-26 - no pledge. Board approved a preferential issue of 18,39,339 fully convertible warrants at Rs87 each (~Rs16cr) to 5 allottees (promoters Dr. Pradeep Khandagale and Mrs. Rajashri Khandagale, plus 3 outside investors), approved at an EGM on 18-Jul-2026, alongside tripling the company's borrowing limit to ~Rs200cr - both aimed at funding working capital for the metro order-book ramp. The worsening debtor-days trend is a real working-capital caution, not a red-flag-tier issue on its own.
bull_case: Confirmed, commercially-evidenced order book of Rs1,021cr+ (~4.2x FY26 revenue), including marquee contracts from L&T (Mumbai Metro Line 4/4A, Rs392cr) and IRCON (Mumbai Metro, Rs485.67cr, design+supply+install+5yr maintenance) - not generic small-town civil work but qualified metro-rail systems sub-contracting
Revenue growth has accelerated sharply and is now order-book-confirmed: Q1 FY27 revenue +252% YoY (Rs104cr vs Rs29cr), off an already-strong ~37% 5-yr CAGR
Statistically inexpensive for the growth rate: ~18x P/E against ~30% ROCE and confirmed hyper-growth quarters

Real diversification optionality via named partnerships: URBS Systems AB (data-centres), Univastu NUOS JV (wireless BMS/IoT), and an exclusive Myrtha Pools partnership (one Rs9cr order already booked)

Promoters (Dr./Mrs. Khandagale) are themselves among the largest allottees in the Rs16cr preferential warrant issue - infusing capital rather than exiting, despite the headline promoter-holding decline
bear_case: Debtor days have risen sharply to ~121 days (FY26-end) from a much lower base - a serious, confirmed working-capital deterioration that forced the board to triple the borrowing limit (to ~Rs200cr) and raise a Rs16cr warrant issue just to fund the growth ramp

Promoter holding has fallen over several consecutive quarters (71.20% Mar-25 -> 67.46% Mar/Jun-26 -> 64.24% Jul-26) - substantially explained by the warrant-dilution math (promoters are participating, not selling), but the multi-quarter direction is real

Growth is heavily order-book/large-client-dependent (L&T, IRCON) - a single client relationship going cold, or execution slippage on any one marquee contract, is a real single-point-of-failure risk for a company this small
New-vertical bets (data-centres, BMS/IoT, aquatics) are still MOU/JV-stage with negligible revenue to date - real optionality, but unproven at any scale
No dividend paid despite consistent profitability (0% payout) and no ValuePickr thread or trusted conviction signal to corroborate the thesis
verdict_headline: Upgraded this pass: a confirmed, order-book-backed metro-rail EPC/systems contractor (L&T + IRCON sub-contractor, Rs1,021cr+ order book, accelerating growth) with real diversification optionality - four_box now clears 3.0 and thesis_fit moves to '10x-in-2-3-years' at Medium conviction, capped by a genuine and severe working-capital deterioration (debtor days to ~121) that must resolve for the thesis to hold.
verdict_reasoning: four_box re-scored 3.5 (up from 2.5): tailwind yes - metro-rail urban-infra capex plus an emerging India data-centre buildout, both structural multi-year drivers, now backed by named contracts rather than a generic sector claim; tam upgraded to yes - the Rs1,021cr order book alone is ~1.9x current market cap and ~4.2x TTM revenue, and the metro-rail pipeline spans multiple Indian cities; moat upgraded to weak (from no) - PWD/CIDCO Class-1A pre-qualification plus a real, repeat sub-contractor/JV relationship with L&T and IRCON is a genuine (if narrow) qualification barrier, though still ultimately competitively tendered; valuation stays yes - ~18x P/E for confirmed 250%+ YoY quarterly growth and 30% ROCE remains statistically inexpensive.

Score >=3.0 permits '10x-in-2-3-years'; applied via the small/mid-cap live-inflection rule (trailing average was already solid at ~37-42%/yr, and the current-quarter inflection is real, catalyst-dated, and evidenced by named, signed contracts from blue-chip clients - not an 'unconfirmed' rumour) - but conviction is capped at Medium, not higher, given the severity of the working-capital deterioration (debtor days to ~121, borrowing limit tripled, a fresh warrant raise) that the growth is currently being funded through.

The multi-quarter promoter-holding decline (71.20%->64.24%) was investigated and found to be substantially a warrant-dilution artifact - promoters Dr./Mrs. Khandagale are themselves the largest allottees in the Rs16cr preferential warrant issue, i.e. infusing capital, not exiting - so this was NOT treated as a HIGH CAUTION promoter-holding-collapse signal, but is flagged for continued monitoring given the multi-quarter direction is still real.

No red flag found (not AVOID/EXCLUDE/HIGH CAUTION tier) - the working-capital strain is a genuine quality caution, not a forensic red flag, given no pledge, no fraud/going-concern signal, and promoter capital participation in the warrant raise.
No dedicated ValuePickr thread resolved (only stale/incidental mentions found); topic_id remains null. No trusted-signal corroboration this pass.

four_box.note: Metro-rail/urban-infra capex tailwind is now order-book-confirmed (L&T, IRCON contracts); TAM is large relative to the tiny market cap (order book alone ~1.9x mcap); moat upgraded to weak on real PWD/CIDCO Class-1A pre-qualification plus repeat blue-chip sub-contractor relationships; valuation stays cheap-looking (~18x P/E) for the confirmed growth rate. Severe working-capital deterioration is the main check on how far this should be pushed and is reflected in conviction, not the four_box score.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Annual revenue growth FY22-26: +47%, +39%, +41%, +42% (Rs59cr -> Rs243cr), followed by a sharp step-up to +252% YoY in Q1 FY27 (Rs104cr vs Rs29cr) as the L&T/IRCON metro order book began executing.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~18x trailing P/E requires only modest further growth to look fair against an already-confirmed +250% YoY quarter and a ~4.2x-revenue order book; the multiple looks undemanding if execution holds, but would look expensive in hindsight if growth reverts sharply toward the ~40% historical average as the order-book base effect fades.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Growth is being funded via a tripled borrowing limit (to ~Rs200cr) and a promoter-participated Rs16cr preferential warrant issue rather than pure dilution to outside investors; reinvestment has coincided with ROCE rising to ~30%. The data-centre/BMS/aquatics diversification moves are adjacent to the core EPC/infrastructure capability, not an unrelated diversification.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Explicit, named move up the value chain: from plain civil EPC to metro-rail systems/signalling-type scope (IRCON's design+supply+install+5yr maintenance contract) and into new verticals (data-centres, BMS/IoT, Olympic-grade aquatics) via MOU/JV structures.

quality_metrics.note: Materially upgrades the original 'no ROCE figure confirmed' framing: ROCE has been consistently strong and improving (17-30% across FY21-25), and the latest screener figure (30.0%) confirms the top end of that range holding into FY26. FCF conversion remains volatile and confirms the debtor-days concern already flagged - operating cash flow was negative in FY25 (-Rs6cr) before recovering to +Rs12cr in FY26; trailing conversion is weak (~5% of EBITDA average) despite the strong ROCE. Gross borrowings are still low in absolute terms (~Rs34cr, Mar-2026) but the board tripled the borrowing limit to ~Rs200cr this pass specifically to fund working capital as debtor days rose to ~121 - a genuine, fresh signal that the growth is currently outrunning cash generation.

track_record.note: FY17, FY18, FY19, FY22, FY23, FY24, FY25 and FY26 each cleared BOTH >=10% revenue growth AND >=15% ROCE (only FY20 and FY21 - COVID-disrupted years - did not); FY26 (confirmed this pass: +42% growth, ROCE 30%) extends the streak. An exceptionally strong Coffee-Can record for a small-cap.

shareholding_pattern.note: Promoter holding declined from 71.20% (Mar-25) to 64.24% (Jul-26), but this substantially reflects dilution from a Rs16cr preferential warrant issue in which the promoter couple (Dr./Mrs. Khandagale) are themselves the largest allottees alongside 3 outside investors - i.e. promoters are infusing fresh capital, not exiting; post-full-conversion promoter stake is projected to recover to ~65.39%. No pledge in any period disclosed (SAST filing confirms nil encumbrance FY25-26). Read as capital-raise dilution rather than a promoter-exit signal, though the multi-quarter direction bears watching. FII/DII split not sourced this pass.

working_capital.note: Debtor days worsened sharply to ~121 days (FY26-end) from a much lower base (sources vary: 15-58 days depending on methodology/period). Screener also flags an extreme negative cash-conversion-cycle figure (-631 days) that is very likely distorted by the scale of the recent revenue jump rather than a literal, meaningful number - not used here. Paired with the company's own ~40-50% growth guidance, an elongating collection cycle is exactly the kind of growth-funded-by-working-capital pattern that can turn a strong P&L story into a cash-flow problem if it isn't arrested; the tripled borrowing limit and warrant raise are direct evidence management is already responding to this.
